title: Senior Software Application Engineer – Ethernet Products (f/m/d)
description:
**Your Team**
 The Ethernet Networking Solutions (ENS) segment is part of the Product Line (PL) In\-Vehicle Networking (IVN) and is one of the fastest growing segments within NXP. The systems \& software team within ENS is responsible for providing software\-related technical support to the field application team, while working closely together with R\&D experts, sales team and directly with customers, worldwide. We are well recognized within the automotive market as experts and belong to the cross\-industry community that introduces novelties in car networking. The location of this vacancy is Hamburg, Germany.
   

  

**Your Tasks And Responsibilities**
* Responsible for customer application support activities and system solutions for Ethernet switch and physical layer products and their application in In\-Vehicle Networks (IVN)
* Respond to technical questions from our customer base, perform code reviews, create code and configuration examples and in general provide help for designing with NXP Ethernet products
* Reproduction and verification of issues reported by customers; if necessary, on\-site support to identify and debug problems both in software and hardware
* Create customer facing technical documents such as application notes, white papers, FAQ’s, product trainings, etc.
* Contribute to internal software development projects
* Responsible for initiation and leading the development of reference designs and product or solution demonstrators
* Cooperate with other software and applications teams within NXP and external 3rd parties to create complete system solution packages and eco\-system.
* Help to carry out trainings and workshops with automotive manufacturers and their electronic subsystem suppliers
* Contribute to thought leadership activities through conferences, trade fairs, articles, etc.


**Required And Desired Skills And Experience**
* Several years of relevant experience of hardware \& embedded software development using automotive semiconductors \& electronics
* Proven hands\-on experience with Ethernet switches, Ethernet physical layer products, interfaces and embedded microcontrollers
* Profound understanding of Ethernet network implementations
* Knowledge of the automotive market and applications is a plus.
* Software knowledge; working with microcontrollers C/C\+\+; Low Level Drivers, Real Time Operating System, Linux, Python
* First experiences in dealing with customers.
* Proven problem solving and debug capabilities.


**Your Education And Personality**
* University degree in Electronics, Communications, Computer Science, or similar
* Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, cross\-cultural mind\-set
* Independent working style, fast learner, creative and open for new ideas
* Fluent in English
